name: criterion-5
text: Criterion 5 (O-1A 5, EB-1A v): original contributions of major significance.

Counts (C5-adoption): shipped work adopted by others: at least 100 stars from accounts other than the founder own, or at least 10 dependents; customer usage; press about the contribution; patents; cited research. Stars and forks from others also count toward #3 as comparable evidence.
Building: adoption below the threshold (C5-below-threshold); a repo starred mostly by the founder own accounts, which are excluded (T-own-stars).
Rejected: commit volume alone; unshipped repos.
